# Let me try pressing LEFT to move the player right on the screen

print("Pressing LEFT 18 times to move towards the nearest bird:")
for i in range(18):
    action(['LEFT'])
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    
    # Get player position
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] == 'O':
            b = n['boundary']
            rows = [p[0] for p in b]
            cols = [p[1] for p in b]
            pr = (min(rows)+max(rows))/2
            pc = (min(cols)+max(cols))/2
            break
    
    # Get nearest bird
    yellow_birds = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'Y' and n['pixels'] == 3]
    nearest_dist = float('inf')
    nearest_bird = None
    for b in yellow_birds:
        b_rows = [p[0] for p in b['boundary']]
        b_cols = [p[1] for p in b['boundary']]
        br = (min(b_rows)+max(b_rows))/2
        bc = (min(b_cols)+max(b_cols))/2
        dist = ((br - pr)**2 + (bc - pc)**2)**0.5
        if dist < nearest_dist:
            nearest_dist = dist
            nearest_bird = (br, bc)
    
    print(f"  After LEFT {i+1}: player=({pr:.1f}, {pc:.1f}), nearest_bird=({nearest_bird[0]:.1f}, {nearest_bird[1]:.1f}), dist={nearest_dist:.1f}, birds={len(yellow_birds)}")
    
    if nearest_dist < 4:
        print(f"  Bird close! Continuing to see if collected...")
    
    if last_action_result.get('level_completed'):
        print("  Level completed!")
        break
    if last_action_result.get('game_over'):
        print("  Game over!")
        break
